title: Cyclic phenomena for composition operators on weighted Bergman spaces
summary: In this article, we study cyclic phenomena on the full range of weighted Bergman spaces on the right half-plane $\mathcal{A}^{2}_α(\mathbb C_{+}).$ We completely characterize cyclic and supercyclic composition operators induced by affine self-maps of $\mathbb C_+,$ thereby completing the characterization of all hypercyclic, supercyclic and cyclic composition operators induced by affine symbols on $\mathcal{A}^{2}_α(\mathbb C_{+}).$
